facts.text: Alpha Arbutin 2% Face Serum
Reduces Dark Spots, Marks & Evens Skin Tone
An anti-pigmentation daily serum with high purity Alpha Arbutin along with Butylresorcinol for dramatically reducing dark spots and blemishes for brighter, even-looking skin.
"Love this product for hyperpigmentation and to reduce acne dark sports and also dark circles. You just need to be patient. -Iram S."
A skin tone enhancing serum with a potent & safe skin lightening active Alpha Arbutin (9 times more effective than Beta Arbutin) that ensures even tone in 5 weeks

Butylresorcinol can strongly inhibit the activity of tyrosinase, resulting in reduction of hyperpigmentation & age spots. Found to have 20 times more potent inhibitory activity than Kojic Acid in a clinical study
Ferulic acid is a powerful antioxidant and can neutralize several different types of free radical. Helps in protecting & also reversing damage caused by UV rays
Formulated with the most effective Alpha Arbutin, sourced from Alfa Aesar, USA
Skin type: Dry/Normal, Sensitive, Oily/Combination, Acne-Prone
Concerns: Hyperpigmentation, Acne Marks, Tanning & Sunspot
Suitable for: 18+ years of age

We conducted in-vitro test (lab test) on skin identical model to evaluate the efficacy of this product in comparison to an Alpha Arbutin 2% serum from an international brand that offers active based products (called benchmark here).

Minimalist Alpha Arbutin 2% Serum reduced melanin concentration significantly higher than the benchmark product. While the benchmark product reduced melanin by 56%, Minimalist Alpha Arbutin 2% reduced melanin concentration by 70%. That is 25% more reduction than the benchmark product.
Study objective: To assess the skin depigmentation efficacy of test products on Melanoderma skin 3D model.
Tissue kit: MEL-312/300B, 12/24
Pigment: Black skin
Study report no: PREC/USSL/SR/2021-144
(Based on an in-vitro study conducted by MS Clinical Research Lab - an independent testing lab)
Apply after cleansing & toning. Apply 2-3 drops. With gentle circular motion, spread it all over your face. Use sunscreen during the day for best results.
When to use: AM & PM. Everyday
Alpha Arbutin and Butylresorcinol together are potent & safe tyrosinase inhibitors and reduce melanin synthesis, making them very effective for reducing hyperpigmentation
90% subjects noticed reduction in hyperpigmentation marks in 8 weeks
90% subjects said skin became clear & even looking in 8 weeks
93% subjects said it reduced sun tanning after 4 weeks of use
Note: The product has been evaluated for safety through patch testing under the supervision of a Dermatologist.
It helps treat hyperpigmentation by effectively reducing the production of melanin
A highly effective tyrosinase inhibitor used for depigmentation purpose. In a study, Butyresorcinol exhibited 20 times more potent inhibitory activity than Kojic Acid
Potent antioxidant that reverses signs of sun damage (UV exposure), and makes skin look even & healthier overall

facts.section: Can Alpha Arbutin be used on dark or brown skin?
facts.text: Alpha Arbutin can be used by all skin tones as it does not change your skin color but evens out your complexion. It lightens the areas that are darker such as age spots, sun damage, hyperpigmentation, etc. due to excessive melanin production, resulting in a natural even skin tone.

facts.section: Can Alpha Arbutin be used on dark or brown skin?
facts.text: Alpha Arbutin is an advanced molecule and does not cause cell cytotoxicity; thus it is a safe skin lightening active suitable for all skin tones.

facts.section: What is the recommended age, and who can use this product?
facts.text: The early-20s is a suitable age for using Alpha Arbutin, as that's when the first signs of age spots & sun damage in the form of pigmentation might start showing.

facts.section: What is the recommended age, and who can use this product?
facts.text: Alpha Arbutin is a milder alternative to other agents like Kojic Acid (which has high cytotoxicity) and is safe to use. However, people with extra sensitive skin should consult a dermatologist before considering incorporating Alpha Arbutin into their skincare.

facts.section: What is the recommended age, and who can use this product?
facts.text: Both males and females with skin concerns like blemishes, acne scars, dark spots, and uneven skin tone can benefit from Alpha Arbutin.
Pregnant or breastfeeding individuals should not use this product without consulting their healthcare provider first.
